notes.title: Star Of The Show - Crashing Fixes Attempt #2 - Teaser
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40550905/2ab5e14dd24a2c5879302fefc31d3617a2f4028e.png[/img]

A few reviews and people are still having crashing issues, the last update for crashing fixes did help several, yet for some it did have issues.

Here is an update that should help some crashes. I had SEVERAL issues regarding start ups. So I had to change a few scripts. Here's what I did.

- Fixed the loading start up scene. No longer will there be a button to continue after an audio warning. After 10 seconds, the menu scene will load from the audio warning. If things are still crashing, I may have to remove this scene and rework the menu.

- Changed several exporting options to the game. This should help with some optimization as well.

- Changed some of the UI in the main menu.

- Added the new [b]Camera Man[/b] character to the menu next to [b]The Tall Man.[/b]

- In the [i]No Key Mode,[/i] added a few models to match the original mode.

Hopefully this fixes some, I genuinely am trying to get this fixed and managed. Some negative reviews on the game were made from crashes, and I'm getting my fixes in. This requires a lot of work, but I have stopped working on the 2.0 version just for these fixes. I'm back on it now. I'm reworking the story and game-play by several tweaks. The new version will change several things. Happy to show it off eventually.

Thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40550905/5e3765beaaa362ba5e77aad4e80abb77cb6a7a43.png[/img]

notes.title: Star Of The Show - Crashing Fixes - Graphical Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40550905/915f9e2781b003594f9f6a8f625dfc4831c63190.png[/img]

Simple enough, we've had some issues on crashes. Hopefully, that's gone now!

I've heard some people going through crashes, and I released small updates thinking it'd be a fix! And hopefully, this is a complete fix for constant crashes when loading the game up. What was the issue? Simple.

[b]I left something unchecked on the final builds on the game.[/b]

Huff, other than that. Other changes were made from this update. It was a small one. Pretty small. But here are some more announcements. 

[b]
- Fixed crashing issues when loading the game up.
- Updated the graphical volume of the game. This is just the tint of the game, basically.
- Adjusted some audio ques. Just the basic outside stuff.
[/b]

I've been working on STAR OF THE SHOW 2.0 for the last few days! Here's what I got so far.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40550905/559d2a17bfd75f58b160da4051ec70b44de14d83.png[/img]
This is going to have new enemies, new mechanics, blah blah. Think of it as a new game, just added to this game! You're gonna still be able to play the original, without a doubt. 

Alright though, that should be it! Thank you for giving the game a go!

notes.title: Star Of The Show 2.0 Announcement / Bug-Fix Update #11
notes.content:
Hello, things have been quiet for a minute, I let the game be what it was for now, and I see some crashing issues, and *hopefully* they have been fixed. I'll be sharing some news as well, here!

[b]- Fixed an issue where the collision on the living room chairs didn't have any collision.
- Potentially fixed a freezing issue when opening the evidence page.
- Adjusted some textures to be less blurry.
- Adjusted the police siren audio from being too loud. (Again.)
- Potentially fixed an issue with the UI cutting off from the screen due to unsupported resolutions.[/b]

Other than the changes above, I will hope to have content being started on for this game. Meaning new content, or even a rework of the house completely. I'd like to change the enemy and hiding system. Add new psychics and add more to the story to make it less hidden.

As well, another enemy who is very expressive.

Basically, to sum things up. 

- New Reworked Enemy System
- New House Rework
- New Enemy AI
- Adding New Animations
- Adding New Websites

And a bit more coming. Considering I just started doing the rework project, it will take some time. But some fixes will be coming along the way, too.

I would also like to say, the content of Star Of The Show 2.0 is going to be FREE. No DLC payment, everything about this project is now free.

You can join the Discord and ask some questions, or even suggest changes or ideas! I've added some ideas from certain players already, and even happy to add more. The slightest ideas will help!

https://discord.gg/ve59sG4

Thank you so much! Get out there, Detective!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40550905/3dc3aac662d1de12de8d35a9cf653a346bd61bd8.gif[/img]

notes.title: Ideas for the game? Post your suggestions!
notes.content:
As the title mentions, I'm happy to improve the game with updates constantly, any suggestions are great!

I've been looking around on the project, and I'm trying to keep it manageable. Though, with a little help from the community, I've made a few updates in less than a week. Five updates so far this week! Fixes and changes, even content.

Though, I'd be happy to take suggestions and content ideas. It's really nice, and if anything is given and I enjoy the idea, I'd be SUPER happy to actually put it in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40550905/56551219ed374cf154501c418672d91e528043c8.gif[/img] 

There is a lot of content in-game already, though... I'd be willing to add more. I'd be really happy to take suggestions as the game can be really frustrating looking for just a key to progress. That's why I made a new game mode to where that takes that mechanic out of just looking for a clickable. This was done in a day!

It's sure a small community, but it was a really good release from my last release. I'm super grateful for anyone to sit down and actually mess around with the game I made. It'll be so much better to have new content instead of just being on the PC most of the time. Any suggestions?

It could be ANYTHING.

- New Enemy
- New PC usage
- New game mechanic outside of the PC
- Anything that comes to mind. 

Once more, I'm super excited to make or change anything. Please don't be afraid to say anything, I'll be happy to consider it and actually put it in. 

Thank you for everything on the release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40550905/d16013bd7401a92913f8d6f8d1fc77f278f935cd.png[/img]

notes.title: Pre-Release Patch Notes - V.1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40550905/56551219ed374cf154501c418672d91e528043c8.gif[/img]

So, Mr. Detective. It may be harder to find your information to update your case, but thankfully. It's all there. Nothing to stop you now.

some updates for Star Of The Show when it's released, a certain patch-note for what will help on release.

UPDATE 1.1
- Added 4 NEW websites.
- Added the MODIFIED SOUND SENSOR ( This is for tracking the enemy, audio isn't the only thing you can look for. )
- Added the SECURITY CAMERA ( Instead of audio, this tracks the enemy visual instead of just audio. )
- Added EXTRA ending.
- Added new audio cues, as well as fake audio cues. You can learn these cues in-game, as they won't change.
- Added new outside interactions.
- Added an extra inside interaction.
- Added KURU. ( Do NOT eat the burger. )
- Changed audio for the PC. Now it's 3D audio.
- Changed the enemy time for spawning. ( Used to be 300 seconds. Should be bumped up quite a bit more. So it isn't constant pressure and hiding. You can sit down and focus for a bit. Could be 10 minutes before a spawn. Could be less. Random chances. )
- Fixed some issues for the ray-cast not being consistent. Should be helpful!
- Added a tutorial board in-game. This helps you learn the game without being so confused. It's always there, too!

Hopefully, some of these additions are helpful and needed. It's awesome for the support given. Thank you so much. You can wish-list the game on Steam now!
 
Thank you for viewing my game in the first place. It's really nice for you to spend a second on my page being interested or not. More updates to come. Could be more enemies, could be several things being added. Really, I'm still figuring it out--

Suggestions are nice. Thank you again!

notes.title: It has been quiet, how about some updates for the next show?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40550905/3dc3aac662d1de12de8d35a9cf653a346bd61bd8.gif[/img]

  Oh man, it's been quiet since we had our shows, we've been preparing for a new contestant is all! How about a taste of some updates coming up.

Seriously, thanks for the support on the project! I've been pretty active on the project and being a solo developer on this project, time goes pretty far when you're on it all at once. Anyways..

Some sad news for a start, originally the game was supposed to release on exactly October 29th. Sadly, I don't have the game completely finished just yet. But to add some good news, the game will be released sometime in November! 

Next month exactly! That's a promise coming from me.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40550905/3646b4726a95d9e6d0d479dbaf1602e057173510.png[/img]

  I'm hoping to have it out before November 15th, I'm this close to finishing it completely. Originally, it was supposed to release but I wasn't completely happy with it. So, adding a lot of new content to the game and an extra enemy to look out for was added. And I'm doing some final touches. Even an extra ending to the game.

There is a nice story in the game! It's mostly hidden and I'm happy with how it has been going. Thankfully, I'm super proud of the project and I hope it satisfies some people. Because I'm really proud of how it came out.

The game was supposed to have these items specifically. 

- 10 websites, now that's up to at least 20-25.

- One Ending, now there are two.

- One enemy, there has been another enemy added! So that's cool.

- Only one way to find the enemy, now you have a security camera as well as a little sound notification.

- Not so interactive home, now I added some enemy stuff to where sometimes they'll pop out of nowhere. Not including a death scene. Just lurking around.

- You couldn't leave the house before, but hey. Now you can and even leave the area. To a police station and even the forest! 

- So much more, I hope you're curious to see how it goes!

Anyways, there has been a lot to share, and I'll be happy to update it more. I won't instantly be quitting after release. Maybe some nice updates and certainly a quality of life update. Bugs and all, the usual. 

But yes, the show will be starting soon. And you're apart of it, my friend.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40550905/56551219ed374cf154501c418672d91e528043c8.gif[/img]
